name: This Life Escapes Me
source:
You are brought back to life for one final hour by a troubled necromancer. He cautiously swears he's from your past. Spend your final moments putting the matter—and you—to rest.

[From [url=https://coda-blue.itch.io/this-life-escapes-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位陷入困境的死灵法师在最后一小时让你复活。他小心翼翼地发誓他是你过去的人。用你的最后时刻来平息这件事——以及你——。

[来自[url=https://coda-blue.itch.io/this-life-escapes-me]itch.io[/url]]
